report.summary: The only failure, test_current_year_is_accepted, is a test bug: it submits THIS_YEAR + 1 (next year) and expects 201, but the app correctly rejects next year with 422 and a parametrized test in the same file requires exactly that rejection. Fix the test first by changing it to use the current year (THIS_YEAR) or deleting it as a duplicate of the next-year case, and do not change app/main.py.

causes.title: test_current_year_is_accepted submits next year instead of the current year
causes.explanation: The test is named 'current year is accepted' but builds its payload with year=THIS_YEAR + 1 (tests/api/test_books_api.py:48). The app's validation (app/main.py:92-96) allows years only up to date.today().year unless the seeded 'year_off_by_one' bug is enabled, in which case next year is also accepted. With the bug off, the app returns 422 for next year, which is the correct behavior. The same file's parametrized test_invalid_book_is_rejected case 'next-year' (tests/api/test_books_api.py:58) asserts that exact 422, so the two tests contradict each other. The failing test is asserting the seeded defect's behavior. No CI configuration in the repo sets BUGS, so the run is using the correct code path, and the 422 is the right result.
evidence: tests/api/test_books_api.py:47-50: def test_current_year_is_accepted(api): response = api.create_book(title=unique("New"), author="Someone", year=THIS_YEAR + 1) ... assert response.status_code == 201
tests/api/test_books_api.py:58: ({"title": "T", "author": "A", "year": THIS_YEAR + 1}, "Year must be between"),  (next-year case expects 422)
app/main.py:94-96: max_year = this_year + 1 if "year_off_by_one" in BUGS else this_year; if not 1 <= book.year <= max_year: raise HTTPException(422, f"Year must be between 1 and {this_year}")
app/main.py:9: year_off_by_one  accepts next year as a publication year
causes.suggested_fix: Change the payload in test_current_year_is_accepted to year=THIS_YEAR so it really tests that the current year is accepted, or remove the test since the parametrized next-year case already covers the boundary. Do not 'fix' the app: relaxing validation to accept next year would reintroduce the year_off_by_one defect.
